newsitem.title: UK: BA STRIKE BOOSTS AIR CANADA CARGO.
newsitem.headline: BA STRIKE BOOSTS AIR CANADA CARGO.

text.p: Air Canada handled a record monthly volume of 8,387 tonnes of air cargo at its Heathrow terminals in July, an airline spokeswoman said.

Cargo flown by Air Canada also set a new monthly record of 5,338 tonnes up 51 percent on July last year aided by the addition of three extra flights during last month's British Airways cabin crew strike, she added.
The Jan-July total of import and export cargo handled by Air Canada at Heathrow was 51,158 tonnes up 17.7 percent on the first seven months of 1996.
Air Canada itself carried 28,168 tonnes in Jan-Jul or an 13.1 percent increase on Jan-July 1996 accounting for 55.1 percent of the total air cargo handled by Air Canada at Heathrow.
The recent addition of Air China to Air Canada's Heathrow clients boosted volume, the Air Canada official said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
